question: From the first year each actor appeared in a film to the last, how many actors in the database never had a gap longer than three consecutive years without at least one new movie appearance, meaning there is no four-year span anywhere in their active career without at least a single film credit?
sql:
-- Final answer: count of actors with no gap > 4 between consecutive movie years
WITH actor_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        c.PID,
        TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) as movie_year
    FROM M_Cast c
    JOIN Movie m ON c.MID = m.MID
    WHERE TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
actor_year_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        PID,
        movie_year,
        LAG(movie_year) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY movie_year) as prev_year
    FROM actor_years
),
actors_with_violation AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT PID
    FROM actor_year_ranked
    WHERE prev_year IS NOT NULL AND (movie_year - prev_year) > 4
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PID) as count_actors
FROM actor_years
WHERE PID NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM actors_with_violation)
